clusters.pattern: Model incorrectly marks presence of empathy or soothing language when telesales only gives minimal or generic acknowledgments (e.g., 'Dạ', 'Ừ rồi dạ chị') without actual empathetic content.
clusters.mechanism: Lack of clear criteria or insufficient training data to distinguish between mere polite acknowledgments and genuine empathetic or soothing responses; model may overgeneralize polite particles as empathy.

clusters.pattern: Model falsely detects presence of open-ended or clarifying questions when telesales only repeats or asks closed questions, or fails to ask any clarifying questions after customer refusal.
clusters.mechanism: Model lacks nuanced understanding of question types (open vs closed) and context of refusal handling; instructions or training data insufficiently emphasize the need for open-ended questions to qualify as làm_rõ.

clusters.pattern: Model marks presence of satisfaction or positive resolution attempts when telesales only lists product benefits or promotions without addressing customer objections or providing tailored solutions.
clusters.mechanism: Model confuses generic product information or promotional talk with actual objection handling or customer satisfaction efforts; lacks grounding in whether telesales addresses customer concerns effectively.

clusters.pattern: Model predicts telesales handling multiple rounds of refusal (round 3) when transcript ends early or customer does not complete refusal rounds, resulting in false positives for làm_dịu, làm_rõ, làm_hài_lòng steps.
clusters.mechanism: Model does not account for incomplete or truncated transcripts and assumes full refusal handling cycles; lacks integration with call length or conversation completeness signals.

clusters.pattern: Model fails to detect absence of empathy or clarifying questions when telesales immediately pushes sales or urgency without acknowledging customer concerns or exploring refusal reasons.
clusters.mechanism: Model over-relies on presence of any telesales speech as positive signal; instructions or training data insufficiently emphasize negative cases where telesales skips empathy or clarification and goes straight to sales pitch or urgency creation.
